name: SecurityTrails
tagline: Historical DNS, WHOIS, and domain intelligence for recon and threat hunting.
description: SecurityTrails API provides historical DNS records, WHOIS data, subdomain discovery, IP intelligence, and domain surface mapping for security research, threat hunting, and attack-surface analysis.

auth.details: API key via APIKEY header (or api_key query param on some endpoints); self-serve signup.

use_cases: look up current DNS for a domain
enumerate historical DNS changes for a domain
get WHOIS history for a domain
find domains associated with an IP
enrich a hostname for threat hunting
